Fresh_Case_1.name: AI_Agent_Workforce_Integration
Fresh_Case_1.original_title: AI Agent Workforce Integration Across Cultures
Fresh_Case_1.background_context: In 2026, a multinational professional-services firm is deploying autonomous AI agents to work alongside human employees in its offices across North America, Western Europe, the Gulf, and East Asia. Early rollouts show sharply different reactions: some regional teams treat the agents as junior colleagues, others as surveillance tools, and others quietly ignore them. Attitudes toward automation, job security, and human-machine authority differ across the firm's cultural contexts.
Fresh_Case_1.business_problem: Design a strategy for integrating autonomous AI agents into human teams across culturally diverse offices, addressing regional differences in trust, perceived job threat, and human-AI collaboration norms.

Fresh_Case_2.name: AI_Act_Compliance_Communication
Fresh_Case_2.original_title: Global AI Product Compliance Under Diverging AI Regulations
Fresh_Case_2.background_context: By 2026, the EU AI Act's high-risk obligations are being enforced, while other jurisdictions have adopted divergent AI rules ranging from light-touch to strict data-localization regimes. A mid-sized company selling an AI-powered hiring platform in fifteen countries must adapt its product, documentation, and marketing to each regime without fragmenting its brand or confusing customers who operate across borders.
Fresh_Case_2.business_problem: Propose a strategy for managing product compliance and customer communication for an AI product sold across jurisdictions with conflicting AI regulations, while maintaining a coherent global brand.

Fresh_Case_3.name: Nearshoring_Supplier_Integration
Fresh_Case_3.background_context: Following the tariff realignments and export-control expansions of 2025, a consumer-electronics manufacturer is shifting part of its supply base from its historical hub in East Asia to new suppliers in Mexico, Morocco, and Vietnam. The new supplier relationships involve unfamiliar business customs, different quality-management traditions, and workforces with distinct communication styles, and early audits reveal misunderstandings about specifications and delivery commitments.
Fresh_Case_3.business_problem: Develop an approach for onboarding and integrating new suppliers from three culturally distinct regions after a rapid nearshoring shift, ensuring quality, trust, and reliable communication.

Fresh_Case_4.name: Four_Day_Week_Global_Policy
Fresh_Case_4.original_title: Designing a Global Flexible-Work Policy for a Multigenerational Workforce
Fresh_Case_4.background_context: In 2026, four-day-week pilots and 'right to disconnect' laws have spread unevenly across countries. A global software company faces pressure from younger employees in some markets demanding compressed weeks, while teams in other markets view reduced office presence as career-damaging or disloyal. Local labor laws, client expectations, and cultural attitudes toward visible effort differ across its twelve country offices.
Fresh_Case_4.business_problem: Design a global flexible-work policy that accommodates divergent cultural attitudes toward working time, visibility, and commitment, while remaining fair, legal, and operationally workable across twelve countries.

Fresh_Case_5.name: Ethical_Fintech_Expansion
Fresh_Case_5.original_title: Values-Based Fintech Expansion into Gulf and Southeast Asian Markets
Fresh_Case_5.background_context: A European fintech startup offering an AI-driven savings and micro-investment app is expanding into the Gulf states, Malaysia, and Indonesia in 2026. Success requires aligning the product with Islamic finance principles, local savings cultures, family-based financial decision-making, and varying levels of trust in automated financial advice, while regulators in each market impose distinct certification processes.
Fresh_Case_5.business_problem: Propose a market-entry and product-adaptation strategy for an AI-driven personal finance app entering values-sensitive markets with distinct religious, familial, and regulatory expectations.

Fresh_Case_6.name: Data_Sovereignty_Cloud_Strategy
Fresh_Case_6.original_title: Communicating a Sovereign-Cloud Transition to Global Customers
Fresh_Case_6.background_context: By 2026, a wave of data-sovereignty laws requires a global SaaS provider to localize customer data in separate national or regional clouds, ending its single-region architecture. Enterprise customers react differently: some celebrate local control, others fear feature delays and price increases, and procurement teams in different countries interpret the change through different lenses of trust in government and in foreign vendors.
Fresh_Case_6.business_problem: Outline a strategy for executing and communicating a sovereign-cloud transition to a culturally diverse global customer base, preserving trust and minimizing churn during the migration.

Fresh_Case_7.name: AI_Companion_Product_Launch
Fresh_Case_7.original_title: Cross-Cultural Launch of an AI Wellbeing Companion
Fresh_Case_7.background_context: A health-tech company is preparing the 2026 international launch of an AI wellbeing companion that offers daily emotional check-ins and mental-health support. Attitudes toward discussing emotions with a machine, mental-health stigma, family involvement in personal wellbeing, and expectations of privacy differ profoundly across its target markets in East Asia, the Middle East, Latin America, and Northern Europe.
Fresh_Case_7.business_problem: Design a culturally differentiated launch strategy for an AI emotional-wellbeing companion, covering positioning, feature adaptation, and trust safeguards across four markedly different cultural regions.

Fresh_Case_8.name: Carbon_Border_Adjustment_Partnerships
Fresh_Case_8.original_title: Helping Emerging-Market Suppliers Through Carbon Border Rules
Fresh_Case_8.background_context: With the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism entering its full financial phase in 2026, a European industrial buyer depends on steel and aluminum suppliers in India, Turkey, and North Africa that now face costly emissions reporting and carbon pricing. The suppliers vary in technical readiness and in how they perceive the mechanism, with some viewing it as disguised protectionism, straining long-standing commercial relationships.
Fresh_Case_8.business_problem: Propose a partnership strategy for supporting emerging-market suppliers through carbon border compliance, preserving supply relationships and shared competitiveness despite differing perceptions of fairness.

Fresh_Case_9.name: Geopolitical_Consumer_Activism
Fresh_Case_9.background_context: In 2025-2026, waves of geopolitically motivated consumer boycotts, amplified by social media and national sentiment, have hit global consumer brands unevenly across regions. A global food-and-beverage company finds the same corporate action praised in one region and boycotted in another, while local franchisees demand contradictory public statements and employees ask the company to take sides.
Fresh_Case_9.business_problem: Develop a framework for how a global consumer brand should act and communicate when geopolitically driven consumer activism pulls its regional markets in opposing directions.

Fresh_Case_10.name: AI_Productivity_Mandate_Change_Management
Fresh_Case_10.original_title: Rolling Out a Mandatory AI-Productivity Toolkit Worldwide
Fresh_Case_10.background_context: In 2026, a global insurance group mandates that all knowledge workers use an approved AI-productivity toolkit, with usage metrics feeding into performance dashboards. Adoption varies dramatically: some country teams embrace it openly, others use it covertly while reporting low usage, and others resist on grounds of professional pride, data privacy, or fear of headcount reduction, with resistance patterns following cultural as much as functional lines.
Fresh_Case_10.business_problem: Design a change-management strategy for a mandatory global AI-tool rollout that addresses culturally distinct patterns of adoption, covert use, and resistance without damaging trust or performance.
